formal_entry.environment: Formal executable + real OpenAI HTTP/SSE adapter/Client/Engine/SQL/Native/CodingToolBundle/Outbox. Only external model and gh services are explicit offline protocol fixtures.

business_assertions: Main-only ticket_note trims and checks a nonempty, at-most-100-word Chinese/English fact, calls the existing Engine.note and returns the routed ticket card; Worker never receives this main tool.

During pause, notes persist without Worker launch. After resume the real Native Worker sees the context-only prefix, performs actual original file work and reports/replies; original mandate is captured read-only before the note and remains identical afterward.

Blank/over-100-word, unknown-ticket and ended-ticket notes visibly fail without adding inputs or inventing tickets. Normal process restart does not repeat recorded notes or completed work; this is not all crash-cut proof.
A blocked-for-human worker retains the note as automatic context without undelivered input, a new worker turn/assignment, file work or result reply. The same state remains across restart.

A waiting worker is different: the context-only note reaches the same actual Native assignment, wakes a new turn, and it completes its original scope. No new mandate, ticket or assignment is invented.
diagnostic_history: tests-01: first new formal path passed; a new test wrongly assumed waiting means blocked-for-human and its model repeatedly posted notes, hitting the bounded deadline. Read the unmodified reference, retained the true blocked/failed hold rule and added a separate waiting-wakes-real-worker test; no domain behavior or frozen assertion was changed.

tests-02: real delivery and waiting-wake tests passed; the renamed blocked test still contained one stale expected string waiting. Corrected only that new assertion to blocked, then ran final full selected regression.
